scientific_integrity: The fixed points and their local stability are credited to Satur (2026); only the global basin, finite branch entry and explicit global contraction are claimed as new. Reproducible finite tests support, but do not prove, the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: All results concern alpha>2 and off-diagonal interior initial maxima. The invariant diagonal, alpha<=2 and boundary inputs equal to one are excluded. The coefficient is a sufficient global bound, not a sharp asymptotic rate. Independent priority and proof validation remain outstanding.
title: Global convergence and an explicit two-step contraction in the supercritical two-player maxima map
